verses.sloka: अथ राजा समृद्ध अर्थः सुग्रीवः प्लवगेश्वरः ।उवाच नरशार्दूलम् रामम् परबलार्दनम् ॥४-४०-१॥
verses.transliteration: atha rājā samṛddha arthaḥ sugrīvaḥ plavageśvaraḥ ।uvāca naraśārdūlam rāmam parabalārdanam ॥4-40-1॥

translations.english: Sugriva, lord of monkeys, who was supported by a massive army informed Rama, the tiger among men and a crusher of the enemy army

verses.sloka: आगता विनिविष्टाः च बलिनः कामरूपिणः ।वानरेन्द्रा महेन्द्र आभा ये मत् विषय वासिनः ॥४-४०-२॥
verses.transliteration: āgatā viniviṣṭāḥ ca balinaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ।vānarendrā mahendra ābhā ye mat viṣaya vāsinaḥ ॥4-40-2॥

translations.english: 'The vanaras living in my kingdom have come and have settled down. They are strong and huge like elephants and they can assume any form at will.

verses.sloka: त इमे बहु विक्रान्तैः बलिभिः भीम विक्रमैः ।आगता वानरा घोरा दैत्य दानव संनिभाः ॥४-४०-३॥
verses.transliteration: ta ime bahu vikrāntaiḥ balibhiḥ bhīma vikramaiḥ ।āgatā vānarā ghorā daitya dānava saṁnibhāḥ ॥4-40-3॥

translations.english: 'Dreadful monkeys, powerful monkeys of fierce valour who resemble demons in form, have arrived.
translations.hindi: ये अनेक स्थानों में अपना बल विक्रम प्रकट कर चुके हैं। ये बड़े भीम पराक्रमी, दैत्य दानवों के समान घोर रूप वाले और बलवान समस्त वानर आ पहुँचे हैं

verses.sloka: ख्यात कर्म अपदानाः च बलवन्तो जित क्लमाः ।पराक्रमेषु विख्याता व्यवसायेषु च उत्तमाः ॥४-४०-४॥
verses.transliteration: khyāta karma apadānāḥ ca balavanto jita klamāḥ ।parākrameṣu vikhyātā vyavasāyeṣu ca uttamāḥ ॥4-40-4॥

translations.english: Powerful vanaras who have earned fame for their valiant deeds in the past, those who are indefatigable and wellknown for their valour having gained preeminence through their efforts and living on several mountains, those who can move on the earth as well as water, crores of them have arrived.
translations.hindi: थे सब युद्धविद्या में प्रसिद्ध है, बड़े बज्ञवान और कभी थकने वाले नहीं हँ । ये प्रसिद्ध पराक्रमी भी हैं और अपने कामों में कुशल हैं

verses.sloka: पृथिवि अंबु चरा राम नाना नग निवासिनः ।कोटि ओघाः च इमे प्राप्ता वानराः तव किंकराः ॥४-४०-५॥
verses.transliteration: pṛthivi aṁbu carā rāma nānā naga nivāsinaḥ ।koṭi oghāḥ ca ime prāptā vānarāḥ tava kiṁkarāḥ ॥4-40-5॥

translations.english: Powerful vanaras who have earned fame for their valiant deeds in the past, those who are indefatigable and wellknown for their valour having gained preeminence through their efforts and living on several mountains, those who can move on the earth as well as water, crores of them have arrived.
translations.hindi: हे राम ! ये सब प्रथिवी आकाश में घूमने वाले, अनेक पर्वताः पर रहने वाले हैं। ये असंख्य बानर जो आए हैं, सो ये सक आप के दास हैं

verses.sloka: निदेश वर्तिनः सर्वे सर्वे गुरु हिते स्थिताः ।अभिप्रेतम् अनुष्ठातुम् तव शक्ष्यन्ति अरिंदम ॥४-४०-६॥
verses.transliteration: nideśa vartinaḥ sarve sarve guru hite sthitāḥ ।abhipretam anuṣṭhātum tava śakṣyanti ariṁdama ॥4-40-6॥

translations.english: 'O Rama,the subduer of foes all of them will follow your command.They are engaged in seeking the wellbeing of elders and can fulfil your wish.
translations.hindi: ये सब अपने बड़ों की आज्ञा मानने वाले और उनके हित में तत्पर रहने वाले हें । हे अरिन्दम! ये आपके इच्छानुसार सवः काम कर सकते हें

verses.sloka: त इमे बहु साहस्रैः अनेकैः बहु विक्रमैः ।आगता वानरा घोरा दैत्य दानव संनिभाः ॥४-४०-७॥
verses.transliteration: ta ime bahu sāhasraiḥ anekaiḥ bahu vikramaiḥ ।āgatā vānarā ghorā daitya dānava saṁnibhāḥ ॥4-40-7॥

translations.english: 'Dreadful monkeys who resemble demons have arrived along with thousands of fierce fighters.

verses.sloka: यत् मन्यसे नरव्याघ्र प्राप्त कालम् तत् उच्यताम् ।तत् सैन्यम् त्वत् वशे युक्तम् आज्ञापयितुम् अर्हसि ॥४-४०-८॥
verses.transliteration: yat manyase naravyāghra prāpta kālam tat ucyatām ।tat sainyam tvat vaśe yuktam ājñāpayitum arhasi ॥4-40-8॥

translations.english: 'O tiger among men announce the proper time for action. This army is at your command. Command them.

verses.sloka: कामम् एषाम् इदम् कार्यम् विदितम् मम तत्त्वतः ।तथा अपि तु यथा युक्तम् आज्ञापयितुम् अर्हसि ॥४-४०-९॥
verses.transliteration: kāmam eṣām idam kāryam viditam mama tattvataḥ ।tathā api tu yathā yuktam ājñāpayitum arhasi ॥4-40-9॥

translations.english: This task is truly known to me in principle; even so, you may duly give the command as is proper.
translations.hindi: सो ये कितनी ही सहस्र भोमविक्रमी सेना आपकी सेवा मेँ उपस्थित है, अब आपका जेसा विचार हो, वैसी समयोचित आज्ञा दीजिए

verses.sloka: तथा ब्रुवाणम् सुग्रीवम् रामो दशरथात्मजः ।बाहुभ्याम् संपरिष्वज्य इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-४०-१०॥
verses.transliteration: tathā bruvāṇam sugrīvam rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ ।bāhubhyām saṁpariṣvajya idam vacanam abravīt ॥4-40-10॥

translations.english: On hearing him, Rama, Dasaratha's son, hugged Sugriva with his arms and said:
translations.hindi: तथापि अ.प इनको यथार्थरीत्या आज्ञा दीजिए । जब सुमीव जे इस प्रकार कहा, तब दशरथनन्दन श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ॥६! बाहुभ्यां सम्परिष्वज्य इदं वचनमब्रवीत्‌ । ज्ञायतां मस वैदेही यदि जीवति वा न वा

verses.sloka: ज्ञायताम् सौम्य वैदेही यदि जीवति वा न वा ।स च देशो महाप्राज्ञ यस्मिन् वसति रावणः ॥४-४०-११॥
verses.transliteration: jñāyatām saumya vaidehī yadi jīvati vā na vā ।sa ca deśo mahāprājña yasmin vasati rāvaṇaḥ ॥4-40-11॥

translations.english: 'O wise warrior I wish to know whether Vaidehi is alive or not. Let the kingdom of Ravana be found out.

verses.sloka: अधिगम्य तु वैदेहीम् निलयम् रावणस्य च ।प्राप्त कालम् विधास्यामि तस्मिन् काले सह त्वया ॥४-४०-१२॥
verses.transliteration: adhigamya tu vaidehīm nilayam rāvaṇasya ca ।prāpta kālam vidhāsyāmi tasmin kāle saha tvayā ॥4-40-12॥

translations.english: 'On locating Vaidehi in the kingdom of Ravana I shall take up proper course of action in conjunction with you.

verses.sloka: न अहम् अस्मिन् प्रभुः कार्ये वानरेन्द्र न लक्ष्मणः ।त्वम् अस्य हेतुः कार्यस्य प्रभुः च प्लवगेश्वर ॥४-४०-१३॥
verses.transliteration: na aham asmin prabhuḥ kārye vānarendra na lakṣmaṇaḥ ।tvam asya hetuḥ kāryasya prabhuḥ ca plavageśvara ॥4-40-13॥

translations.english: 'O lord of monkeys neither I nor my brother Lakshmana should command the monkeys. You are the right person to do it.

verses.sloka: त्वम् एव आज्ञापय विभो मम कार्य विनिश्चयम् ।त्वम् हि जानासि यत् कार्यम् मम वीर न संशयः ॥४-४०-१४॥
verses.transliteration: tvam eva ājñāpaya vibho mama kārya viniścayam ।tvam hi jānāsi yat kāryam mama vīra na saṁśayaḥ ॥4-40-14॥

translations.english: 'O king you have understood the task to be performed and, therefore, issue orders without the least hesitation.
translations.hindi: हे बीर ! तुम निस्सन्देह मेरे काम को जानते हो । एक तो तुम मेरे हितैषी, दूसरे पराक्रमी, तोसरे बुद्धिमान ओर चौथे समय को ज्ञानने वाले हो

verses.sloka: सुहृद् द्वितीयो विक्रान्तः प्राज्ञः काल विशेष वित् ।भवान् अस्मत् हिते युक्तः सुहृद् आप्तो अर्थवित्तमः ॥४-४०-१५॥
verses.transliteration: suhṛd dvitīyo vikrāntaḥ prājñaḥ kāla viśeṣa vit ।bhavān asmat hite yuktaḥ suhṛd āpto arthavittamaḥ ॥4-40-15॥

translations.english: 'You are my second friend (Lakshmana being the first). You are valiant as well as wise. You are aware of timely action. You are interested in my wellbeing. You are capable. You know my purpose. You are a startegic planner'. (The present purpose is to plan the course of action. That is artha. Sugriva knows this artha very well).
translations.hindi: आप मेरे हित में तत्पर बुद्द हें तथा अर्थवेत्ता हें । जब रामचन्द्र जी ने सुग्रीव से इस प्रकार कहा, तब सुप्रीब ने, बुद्धि- मान श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ओर लक्ष्मण जी ही के आगे, विनत नामक यथपति से, जे। पर्वेताकार था और मेघ की तरह गरज रहा था; कहा

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु सुग्रीवो विनतम् नाम यूथपम् ।अब्रवीत् राम सांनिध्ये लक्ष्मणस्य च धीमतः ॥४-४०-१६॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu sugrīvo vinatam nāma yūthapam ।abravīt rāma sāṁnidhye lakṣmaṇasya ca dhīmataḥ ॥4-40-16॥

translations.english: 'In response to Rama's desire, Sugriva beckoned a troopleader called Vinata who was wellbuilt and lofty like a mountain. And thundering like a cloud, said to him in the presence of Rama and wise Lakshmana:

verses.sloka: शैलाभम् मेघ निर्घोषम् ऊर्जितम् प्लवगेश्वरम् ।सोम सूर्य निभैः सार्धम् वानरैः वानरोत्तम ॥४-४०-१७॥
verses.transliteration: śailābham megha nirghoṣam ūrjitam plavageśvaram ।soma sūrya nibhaiḥ sārdham vānaraiḥ vānarottama ॥4-40-17॥

translations.english: 'O foremost of the vanaras march forward with the sons of Moon and Sun, followed by one lakh swift monkeys towards the eastern direction full of mountains, gardens, and forests. Endowed with political wisdom, you are capable of taking right decision in accordance with time and place.
translations.hindi: हे वानरोत्तम ! चन्द्र सूय की तरह वर्ण वाले वानरो को जो देश काल और नीति के जानने चाले तथा जे करने श्रनकरने कार्यी के विषय में निश्चय करने की योग्यता रखने बले एवं बलवान एक लक्ष वानरों को साथ ले. तुम पूर्वे दिशा को जाओ आर वहाँ पर पत्तों और काननों में

verses.sloka: देश काल नयैः युक्तः विज्ञः कार्य विनिश्चये ।वृतः शत सहस्रेण वानराणाम् तरस्विनाम् ॥४-४०-१८॥
verses.transliteration: deśa kāla nayaiḥ yuktaḥ vijñaḥ kārya viniścaye ।vṛtaḥ śata sahasreṇa vānarāṇām tarasvinām ॥4-40-18॥

translations.english: 'O foremost of the vanaras march forward with the sons of Moon and Sun, followed by one lakh swift monkeys towards the eastern direction full of mountains, gardens, and forests. Endowed with political wisdom, you are capable of taking right decision in accordance with time and place.

verses.sloka: अधिगच्छ दिशम् पूर्वाम् स शैल वन काननाम् ।तत्र सीताम् च वैदेहीम् निलयम् रावणस्य च ॥४-४०-१९॥
verses.transliteration: adhigaccha diśam pūrvām sa śaila vana kānanām ।tatra sītām ca vaidehīm nilayam rāvaṇasya ca ॥4-40-19॥

translations.english: 'Search for Sita in the abode of Ravana, on mountain peaks and river banks and in forests.

verses.sloka: मार्गध्वम् गिरि दुर्गेषु वनेषु च नदीषु च ।नदीम् भागीरथीम् रम्याम् सरयूम् कौशिकीम् तथा ॥४-४०-२०॥
verses.transliteration: mārgadhvam giri durgeṣu vaneṣu ca nadīṣu ca ।nadīm bhāgīrathīm ramyām sarayūm kauśikīm tathā ॥4-40-20॥

translations.english: 'Look for Sita in the beautiful places on rivers Bhagirathi, Sarayu, Kausiki and Kalindi, on the great mountains adjacent to river Yamuna, banks of rivers Saraswati, Sindhu, Sona with crystalclear waters, the country of Mahim and Kalamahi adorned with mountains and forests. Proceed to Brahmamala, Videha, Malava, Kasi, Kosala and Maghada with great villages, the country of Pundram, Vanga, the country famous for silk worms and the land with silver caves. (It is the eastern direction of river Saravati between Himavat and Vindhya and not east of Kiskinda)
translations.hindi: भागीरथी गङ्गा, रमणीक सरयू, कौशिकी, कालिन्दी यमा ओर रमणीक यमुनातटवती विशाल पर्वत, सरस्वती, सिन्धु, मणि की तरह स्वच्छ जल वाला सोनभद्र, नदी ओर पवतो बनं सहित कालसही नदियों को ढू ढो

verses.sloka: कालिंदीम् यमुनाम् रम्याम् यामुनम् च महागिरिम् ।सरस्वतीम् च सिंधुम् च शोणम् मणि निभ उदकम् ॥४-४०-२१॥
verses.transliteration: kāliṁdīm yamunām ramyām yāmunam ca mahāgirim ।sarasvatīm ca siṁdhum ca śoṇam maṇi nibha udakam ॥4-40-21॥

translations.english: 'Look for Sita in the beautiful places on rivers Bhagirathi, Sarayu, Kausiki and Kalindi, on the great mountains adjacent to river Yamuna, banks of rivers Saraswati, Sindhu, Sona with crystalclear waters, the country of Mahim and Kalamahi adorned with mountains and forests. Proceed to Brahmamala, Videha, Malava, Kasi, Kosala and Maghada with great villages, the country of Pundram, Vanga, the country famous for silk worms and the land with silver caves. (It is the eastern direction of river Saravati between Himavat and Vindhya and not east of Kiskinda)

verses.sloka: महीम् कालमहीम् चैव शैल कानन शोभिताम् ।ब्रह्ममालान् विदेहान् च मालवान् काशि कोसलान् ॥४-४०-२२॥
verses.transliteration: mahīm kālamahīm caiva śaila kānana śobhitām ।brahmamālān videhān ca mālavān kāśi kosalān ॥4-40-22॥

translations.english: 'Look for Sita in the beautiful places on rivers Bhagirathi, Sarayu, Kausiki and Kalindi, on the great mountains adjacent to river Yamuna, banks of rivers Saraswati, Sindhu, Sona with crystalclear waters, the country of Mahim and Kalamahi adorned with mountains and forests. Proceed to Brahmamala, Videha, Malava, Kasi, Kosala and Maghada with great villages, the country of Pundram, Vanga, the country famous for silk worms and the land with silver caves. (It is the eastern direction of river Saravati between Himavat and Vindhya and not east of Kiskinda)

verses.sloka: मागधाम् च महाग्रामान् पुण्ड्रान् अंगाम् तथैव च ।भूमिम् च कोशकाराणाम् भूमिम् च रजत आकराम् ॥४-४०-२३॥
verses.transliteration: māgadhām ca mahāgrāmān puṇḍrān aṁgām tathaiva ca ।bhūmim ca kośakārāṇām bhūmim ca rajata ākarām ॥4-40-23॥

translations.english: 'Look for Sita in the beautiful places on rivers Bhagirathi, Sarayu, Kausiki and Kalindi, on the great mountains adjacent to river Yamuna, banks of rivers Saraswati, Sindhu, Sona with crystalclear waters, the country of Mahim and Kalamahi adorned with mountains and forests. Proceed to Brahmamala, Videha, Malava, Kasi, Kosala and Maghada with great villages, the country of Pundram, Vanga, the country famous for silk worms and the land with silver caves. (It is the eastern direction of river Saravati between Himavat and Vindhya and not east of Kiskinda)
translations.hindi: उन नगरौं को भी खोजो जहाँ रेशम के कीड़े Fe ७: जहाँ चाँदी की खानें हैं. । तुम इन सब ल घुम ॥ सु र बम थ्‌ आर श्रीरामचन्द्र ज सर्वत्र महाराज दशरथ की पुत्रबधू री च्यारी भाया सीता को ढुँढो । समुद्र के बीच जो टापू हैँ, उन पहाड़ों और नगरों में सी ढू इना

verses.sloka: सर्वम् च तत् विचेतव्यम् मार्गयद्भिः ततः ततः ।रामस्य दयिताम् भार्याम् सीताम् दशरथः स्नुषाम् ॥४-४०-२४॥
verses.transliteration: sarvam ca tat vicetavyam mārgayadbhiḥ tataḥ tataḥ ।rāmasya dayitām bhāryām sītām daśarathaḥ snuṣām ॥4-40-24॥

translations.english: 'Search all over the place looking carefully here and there for Sita the beloved consort of Rama, daughterinlaw of Dasaratha.

verses.sloka: समुद्रम् अवगाढान् च पर्वतान् पत्तनानि च ।मंदरस्य च ये कोटिम् संश्रिताः केचित् आलयाः ॥४-४०-२५॥
verses.transliteration: samudram avagāḍhān ca parvatān pattanāni ca ।maṁdarasya ca ye koṭim saṁśritāḥ kecit ālayāḥ ॥4-40-25॥

translations.english: 'There are people who have taken shelter in the deep pits in the midst of the sea, in deep valleys, mountains, cities and broad peaks of Mandara mountain and forests.All those regions should be thoroughly searched. There are innumerable inhabitants,such as strong cannibals, some who cover their ears, some who have ears extended up to the lips, some with dreadful metallic faces, some swiftmoving, onefooted indestructible beings. There are Kirata tribes of golden complexion and handsome looks whose tuft of hair is set to the sides so that it touches their ears. These Kiratas are Islanddwellers and they eat uncooked fish.They move in waters and are fierce, known as tigerlike men (Naravyagras because half of their body is human and other half is tiger in form). All the shelters of these forestdwellers should be searched well.Those who can be sent by crossing mountains, those who can leap (in air) and those who can swim through waters may be also dispatched.

verses.sloka: कर्ण प्रावरणाः चैव तथा च अपि ओष्ठ कर्णकाः ।घोर लोह मुखाः चैव जवनाः च एक पादकाः ॥४-४०-२६॥
verses.transliteration: karṇa prāvaraṇāḥ caiva tathā ca api oṣṭha karṇakāḥ ।ghora loha mukhāḥ caiva javanāḥ ca eka pādakāḥ ॥4-40-26॥

verses.transliteration: akṣayā balavaṁtaḥ ca tathaiva puruṣa ādakāḥ ।kirātāḥ tīkṣṇa cūḍāḥ ca hemābhāḥ priya darśanāḥ ॥4-40-27॥

verses.transliteration: āma mīna aśanāḥ cāpi kirātā dvīpa vāsinaḥ ।aṁtar jala carā ghorā naravyāghrā iti smṛtāḥ ॥4-40-28॥

verses.transliteration: eteṣām āśrayāḥ sarve viceyāḥ kānana okasaḥ ।giribhir ye ca gamyante plavanena plavena ca ॥4-40-29॥

verses.sloka: यत्नवन्तो यव द्वीपम् सप्त राज्य उपशोभितम् ।सुवर्ण रूप्यकम् द्वीपम् सुवर्ण आकर मण्डितम् ॥४-४०-३०॥
verses.transliteration: yatnavanto yava dvīpam sapta rājya upaśobhitam ।suvarṇa rūpyakam dvīpam suvarṇa ākara maṇḍitam ॥4-40-30॥

translations.english: 'Go beyond Java island filled with precious gems. It has seven kingdoms. It is adorned with gold and silver mines in abundance. There is a mountain Sisira (abode of Garuda) beyond Java Island. It touches the sky with its lofty cliffs. Gods and demons visit this mountain. You may look for illustrious Rama's consort in these inaccessible mountains, waterfalls and forests.
translations.hindi: गिरिभिर्ये च गम्यन्ते पुवनेन पुवेन च । रन्नवन्तं यवद्वीपं सप्तराज्योपशोभितम्‌ । २&॥। जिन स्थानों में पर्वेतो पर से साग हो अथवा जहाँ घरनयी या नाव से जा सको, बहाँ जाकर ढुँदना । सात राज्यों से सुशोभित रत्नवान्‌ यवद्धीप में भी जाना ॥२६! सुवणरूप्यकं चैव सुव्शाकरमण्डितम्‌ ¦ यवद्वीपमतिक्रम्य शिशिरो नाम पवतः

verses.sloka: यव द्वीपम् अतिक्रम्य शिशिरो नाम पर्वतः ।दिवम् स्पृशति शृन्गेण देव दानव सेवितः ॥४-४०-३१॥
verses.transliteration: yava dvīpam atikramya śiśiro nāma parvataḥ ।divam spṛśati śṛngeṇa deva dānava sevitaḥ ॥4-40-31॥

translations.hindi: मागेध्वं सहिताः सवे रामपत्नीं यशस्विनीम्‌ । ` ततो रक्तजलं शोणमगाघं शीधाहिनम्‌ !!३२॥ . इस पवेत के शिखर आकाशध्पशी हँओर उन पर देवता दानव रहा करते हैं । इन सेव गिरिदुर्ग, नदी केमुहानों पर और बनो में तुम सब मिल कर यशस्विनी रामपत्नी सीता का पता लगाना । फिर, लाल रंग का अगाध जल वाला और बड़ी तेज चार बाला शोण नामक नद्‌ मिलेगा

verses.sloka: एतेषाम् गिरि दुर्गेषु प्रपातेषु वनेषु च ।मार्गध्वम् सहिताः सर्वे राम पत्नीम् यशस्विनीम् ॥४-४०-३२॥
verses.transliteration: eteṣām giri durgeṣu prapāteṣu vaneṣu ca ।mārgadhvam sahitāḥ sarve rāma patnīm yaśasvinīm ॥4-40-32॥

verses.sloka: ततो रक्त जलम् प्राप्य शोण आख्यम् शीघ्र वाहिनीम् ।गत्वा पारम् समुद्रस्य सिद्ध चारण सेवितम् ॥४-४०-३३॥
verses.transliteration: tato rakta jalam prāpya śoṇa ākhyam śīghra vāhinīm ।gatvā pāram samudrasya siddha cāraṇa sevitam ॥4-40-33॥

translations.english: 'Therefrom reach out to the swiftflowing river Sona which has redcoloured waters. Then crossing the sea which is the abode of Siddhas and Charanas search the different rivers reaching the sea, and the picturesque and wonderful forests to trace the abode of Ravana who has stolen Sita.
translations.hindi: फिर समुद्र के उस पार जाना । वहाँ सिद्धो और चारणं से सेबित उसके तटों पर, रम्य विचित्र वनों में रावण सहित जानकी जी को इधर उधर तलाश करना । वहां पर पहाड़ी नदियों के लटों पर बहुत से रमणीक उद्यान हैं.

verses.sloka: तस्य तीर्थेषु रम्येषु विचित्रेषु वनेषु च ।रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः ॥४-४०-३४॥
verses.transliteration: tasya tīrtheṣu ramyeṣu vicitreṣu vaneṣu ca ।rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ ॥4-40-34॥

translations.english: 'Therefrom reach out to the swiftflowing river Sona which has redcoloured waters. verses.sloka: पर्वत प्रभवा नद्यः सुभीम बहु निष्कुटाः ।मार्गितव्या दरीमन्तः पर्वताः च वनानि च ॥४-४०-३५॥
verses.transliteration: parvata prabhavā nadyaḥ subhīma bahu niṣkuṭāḥ ।mārgitavyā darīmantaḥ parvatāḥ ca vanāni ca ॥4-40-35॥

translations.english: 'Then you may continue your search in the frightening islands of the sea as well as the sea which roars when stirred up by the wind.

verses.sloka: ततः समुद्र द्वीपान् च सुभीमान् द्रष्टुम् अर्हथ ।ऊर्मिमंतम् महारौद्रम् क्रोशंतम् अनिल उद्धितम् ॥४-४०-३६॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samudra dvīpān ca subhīmān draṣṭum arhatha ।ūrmimaṁtam mahāraudram krośaṁtam anila uddhitam ॥4-40-36॥

translations.english: 'Demons of huge bodies catch the shadows of passersby in that place as they have been hungry for long and have the permission of Brahma to do so.
translations.hindi: वहाँ पर बड़ी बड़ों लहरें उठती हैँ और वायु के संयोग से समुद्र नाद करता है वहाँ पर बढ़े बड़े शारीर डाले अछुर लोग रहते हैं जो सदैब समुद्र के ऊपर वालों की छाया पकड़ लेते हैं

verses.sloka: तत्र असुरा महाकायाः छायाम् गृह्णन्ति नित्यशः ।ब्रह्मणा समनुज्ञाता दीर्घ कालम् बुभुक्षिताः ॥४-४०-३७॥
verses.transliteration: tatra asurā mahākāyāḥ chāyām gṛhṇanti nityaśaḥ ।brahmaṇā samanujñātā dīrgha kālam bubhukṣitāḥ ॥4-40-37॥

translations.english: 'Reach out to the great roaring ocean which looks like a black cloud at the time of dissolution, inhabited by great serpents.Go through the bank of the river, and touch the frightening sea named Lohita of red coloured water.You will see a huge silkcotton tree in that place.
translations.hindi: निष्कुटाः--उद्यानविशेषा: । ( गो० ) आकाशचारिरों की छाय पकड़ने के लिए उनको ब्रह्मा जी की आज्ञा है। वे बहत दिनों से भखे हैं । तुम उस प्रलयकालीन मेघां के समान तथाबड़े सपासे युक्त

verses.sloka: तम् काल मेघ प्रतिमम् महोरग निषेवितम् ।अभिगम्य महानादम् तीर्थेन एव महोदधिम् ॥४-४०-३८॥
verses.transliteration: tam kāla megha pratimam mahoraga niṣevitam ।abhigamya mahānādam tīrthena eva mahodadhim ॥4-40-38॥

translations.english: 'Reach out to the great roaring ocean which looks like a black cloud at the time of dissolution, inhabited by great serpents.Go through the bank of the river, and touch the frightening sea named Lohita of red coloured water.You will see a huge silkcotton tree in that place.
translations.hindi: उस महानाद करते हुए समुद्र के किनारे किनारे ही जाना अथवा बड़ी सावधानी से जाना और उन छायाप्राहियों से सावधान रहना । तदनन्तर तुमको लाल जल का लोहित नामक भयङ्कर समुद्र मिलेगा

verses.sloka: ततो रक्तजलम् भीमम् लोहितम् नाम सागरम् ।गत्वा प्रेक्ष्यथ ताम् चैव बृहतीम् कूटशाल्मलीम् ॥४-४०-३९॥
verses.transliteration: tato raktajalam bhīmam lohitam nāma sāgaram ।gatvā prekṣyatha tām caiva bṛhatīm kūṭaśālmalīm ॥4-40-39॥

translations.english: 'You would see there a house of Garuda constructed by Visvakarma. It looks like the Kailasa mountain and is adorned with different kinds of gems.

verses.sloka: गृहम् च वैनतेयस्य नाना रत्न विभूषितम् ।तत्र कैलास संकाशम् विहितम् विश्वकर्मणा ॥४-४०-४०॥
verses.transliteration: gṛham ca vainateyasya nānā ratna vibhūṣitam ।tatra kailāsa saṁkāśam vihitam viśvakarmaṇā ॥4-40-40॥

translations.english: 'There are frightening demons called Mandehas of different forms, fearsome as huge mountains hanging down the mountain peaks.
translations.hindi: वह घर केलास को तरह विश्वकर्मा ने वानाया है। वहाँ नानारूप धारी पवताकार ओरभयङ्कर सन्देह नामी राक्षस “पर्वत १ तीर्थनाभियग्य--उपायोभिगम्य । ( गोऽ ) ० < y रश: सगः ३६५ शिखरों पर लटका करते हैं । जब सूर्य उदय होते हैं, तब सूयं के ताप से तप्त हो नित्य ब्राह्मणों की अध्यांञ्जलि से ये मारे जाते हैं ओर सूर्यं के ताप से तप्त हो, फिर पर्वतशिखर पर लटक जाते हैं

verses.sloka: तत्र शैल निभा भीमा मन्देहा नाम राक्षसाः ।शैल शृंगेषु लंबन्ते नाना रूपा भयावहाः ॥४-४०-४१॥
verses.transliteration: tatra śaila nibhā bhīmā mandehā nāma rākṣasāḥ ।śaila śṛṁgeṣu laṁbante nānā rūpā bhayāvahāḥ ॥4-40-41॥

translations.english: 'Those demons keep dropping down in water at the time of Sunrise every day, by the power of Gayatri mantras recited by brahmins scorched by the heat of the Sun. Again and again they keep hanging on to the cliffs.

verses.sloka: ते पतन्ति जले नित्यम् सूर्यस्य उदयनम् प्रति ।अभितप्ताः च सूर्येण लंबन्ते स्म पुनः पुनः ॥४-४०-४२॥
verses.transliteration: te patanti jale nityam sūryasya udayanam prati ।abhitaptāḥ ca sūryeṇa laṁbante sma punaḥ punaḥ ॥4-40-42॥

translations.english: 'You who are unassailable by the enemies, will see the milky ocean appearing like clouds, resembling a pearl necklace with its rows of waves.
translations.hindi: ह 2 2. पहाड़ के शिखर पर सब देवताओं से नमस्कृत, सहरू मस्तक बाले अनन्त जो नीलाम्बर धारण किए हुए बैठे रहते है

verses.sloka: निहता ब्रह्म तेजोभिः अहनि अहनि राक्षसाः ।ततः पाण्डुर मेघाभम् क्षीरौदम् नाम सागरम् ॥४-४०-४३॥
verses.transliteration: nihatā brahma tejobhiḥ ahani ahani rākṣasāḥ ।tataḥ pāṇḍura meghābham kṣīraudam nāma sāgaram ॥4-40-43॥

translations.english: 'In the midst of that ocean stands a majestic white mountain named Rishaba surrounded by trees filled with silver flowers emitting wonderful fragrance.There is also a lake named Sudarsana with glittering silver lotuses having gleaming golden filaments. Royal swans inhabit these surroundings.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर सफेद बादल के रंग वाला क्षीरोद नाम का समुद्र है । वहाँ जाने पर तुम देखोगे कि, वह अपनी लहरों से मोती के हार की तरह जान पड़ता है

verses.sloka: गत्वा द्रक्ष्यथ दुर्धर्षा मुक्ता हारम् इव ऊर्मिभिः ।तस्य मध्ये महा श्वेतो ऋषभो नाम पर्वतः ॥४-४०-४४॥
verses.transliteration: gatvā drakṣyatha durdharṣā muktā hāram iva ūrmibhiḥ ।tasya madhye mahā śveto ṛṣabho nāma parvataḥ ॥4-40-44॥

translations.english: 'In the midst of that ocean stands a majestic white mountain named Rishaba surrounded by trees filled with silver flowers emitting wonderful fragrance.There is also a lake named Sudarsana with glittering silver lotuses having gleaming golden filaments. Royal swans inhabit these surroundings.
translations.hindi: चीरोद समुद्र के बीच में ऋषभ ताम का एक पहाड़ है। उस पर दिव्य गन्ध युक्त फले फूले सघ" पेड़ लग रहे हैं

verses.sloka: दिव्य गन्धैः कुसुमितै आचितैः च नगैः वृतः ।सरः च राजतैः पद्मैः ज्वलितैः हेम केसरैः ॥४-४०-४५॥
verses.transliteration: divya gandhaiḥ kusumitai ācitaiḥ ca nagaiḥ vṛtaḥ ।saraḥ ca rājataiḥ padmaiḥ jvalitaiḥ hema kesaraiḥ ॥4-40-45॥

translations.english: 'The deities, called charanas, yakshas and kinneras, also apsarasas keep coming there to stoll by that lotus pond.
translations.hindi: डस पर्वत पर ही सुदर्शन नाम का एक तालाब है जिसमें खुन- हले रंग के कमल के फूल सुशोभित हो रहे हें ओर वहा राजहंस किलोलें किश्रा करते हैँ

verses.sloka: नाम्ना सुदर्शनम् नाम राजहंसैः समाकुलम् ।विबुधाः चारणा यक्षाः किन्नराः स अप्सरो गणाः ॥४-४०-४६॥
verses.transliteration: nāmnā sudarśanam nāma rājahaṁsaiḥ samākulam ।vibudhāḥ cāraṇā yakṣāḥ kinnarāḥ sa apsaro gaṇāḥ ॥4-40-46॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys going beyond the milky ocean you will see the seas most dreadful to all creatures.
translations.hindi: उस सरोवर से तट पर बहुत से चारण, यक्ष किन्नर ओर अप्सराएँ हर्षित हो कीड़ा करने के लिए घूमा करती हैं

verses.sloka: हृष्टाः समधिगच्छन्ति नलिनीम् ताम् रिरंसवः ।क्षीरोदम् समतिक्रम्य ततो द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः ॥४-४०-४७॥
verses.transliteration: hṛṣṭāḥ samadhigacchanti nalinīm tām riraṁsavaḥ ।kṣīrodam samatikramya tato drakṣyatha vānarāḥ ॥4-40-47॥

translations.english: 'Here is born Hayamukha, out of the fastspreading fire of anger of the ocean. Its movable and immovable creatures constitute his food.
translations.hindi: है जानरगण ! क्षोरसागर उतरने के बाद जलोद नामक सागर मिलेगा । यह समुद्र सब प्राणियों को भय उपजाने बाला है

verses.sloka: जलोदम् सागरम् शीघ्रम् सर्व भूत भयावहम् ।तत्र तत् कोपजम् तेजः कृतम् हयमुखम् महत् ॥४-४०-४८॥
verses.transliteration: jalodam sāgaram śīghram sarva bhūta bhayāvaham ।tatra tat kopajam tejaḥ kṛtam hayamukham mahat ॥4-40-48॥

translations.english: 'You can hear the sounds of helpless oceanic creatures crying loudly on seeing the burning face of Vadava.

verses.sloka: अस्य आहुः तन् महावेगम् ओदनम् स चराचरम् ।तत्र विक्रोशताम् नादो भूतानाम् सागर ओकसाम् ।श्रूयते च असमर्थानाम् दृष्ट्वा तत् वडवा मुखम् ॥४-४०-४९॥
verses.transliteration: asya āhuḥ tan mahāvegam odanam sa carācaram ।tatra vikrośatām nādo bhūtānām sāgara okasām ।śrūyate ca asamarthānām dṛṣṭvā tat vaḍavā mukham ॥4-40-49॥

translations.english: 'Thirteen yojanas to the north of this ocean of pure waters is a huge golden mountain called Jatarupasila.

verses.sloka: स्वादु उदस्य उत्तरे देशे योजनानि त्रयोदश ।जातरूप शिलो नाम सुमहान् कनक प्रभः ॥४-४०-५०॥
verses.transliteration: svādu udasya uttare deśe yojanāni trayodaśa ।jātarūpa śilo nāma sumahān kanaka prabhaḥ ॥4-40-50॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys on top of the mountain you will see Ananta, a thousandhooded serpent seated, as bright as the Moon, robed in blue, with large eyes like lotus petals bearing the load of the earth, and revered by all beings.
translations.hindi: स्वाद ससुद्र के उत्तर तट पर तेरह योजन विस्तार वाला सोने की तरह प्रभावत्राला एक बड़ा पहाड़ हे, जितका नास जात रूपशिल है

verses.sloka: तत्र चन्द्र प्रतीकाशम् पन्नगम् धरणी धरम् ।पद्म पत्र विशालाक्षम् ततो द्रक्ष्यध वानराः ॥४-४०-५१॥
verses.transliteration: tatra candra pratīkāśam pannagam dharaṇī dharam ।padma patra viśālākṣam tato drakṣyadha vānarāḥ ॥4-40-51॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys on top of the mountain you will see Ananta, a thousandhooded serpent seated, as bright as the Moon, robed in blue, with large eyes like lotus petals bearing the load of the earth, and revered by all beings.
translations.hindi: चट ; संग: २६० हे वानरों ! वहाँ तुम लोग चन्द्रमा की तरह सफेद प्रभा बाले ओर कमलपत्र की तरह बड़े नेत्रों वाले एक धरणीधर सपं को देखोगे

verses.sloka: आसीनम् पर्वतस्य अग्रे सर्व भूत नमस्कृतम् ।सहस्र शिरसम् देवम् अनंतम् नील वाससम् ॥४-४०-५२॥
verses.transliteration: āsīnam parvatasya agre sarva bhūta namaskṛtam ।sahasra śirasam devam anaṁtam nīla vāsasam ॥4-40-52॥

translations.english: 'Highsouled Ananta's flag is a threeheaded golden palm tree shining on an altar on top of the mountain.

verses.sloka: त्रिशिराः कांचनः केतुः तालः तस्य महात्मनः ।स्थापितः पर्वतस्य अग्रे विराजति स वेदिकः ॥४-४०-५३॥
verses.transliteration: triśirāḥ kāṁcanaḥ ketuḥ tālaḥ tasya mahātmanaḥ ।sthāpitaḥ parvatasya agre virājati sa vedikaḥ ॥4-40-53॥

translations.english: 'The flag of Ananta is fixed by the gods in the eastern direction. Beyond that stands the famous golden mountain behind which the sun rises. Its golden peak with a divine altar spread over a hundred yojanas touches heaven.

verses.sloka: पूर्वस्याम् दिशि निर्माणम् कृतम् तत् त्रिदशेश्वरैः ।ततः परम् हेममयः श्रीमान् उदय पर्वतः ॥४-४०-५४॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvasyām diśi nirmāṇam kṛtam tat tridaśeśvaraiḥ ।tataḥ param hemamayaḥ śrīmān udaya parvataḥ ॥4-40-54॥

translations.english: 'The flag of Ananta is fixed by the gods in the eastern direction. Beyond that stands the famous golden mountain behind which the sun rises. Its golden peak with a divine altar spread over a hundred yojanas touches heaven.
translations.hindi: उसी पर्वत के शिखर पर तीन शाखा वाला, सुनहला, ताल पूर्वस्यां दिशि निर्माणं कृतं तत्रिदशेश्वरः । तत! परं हेममयः श्रीसाचुदयपवतः

verses.sloka: तस्य कोटिः दिवम् स्पृष्ट्वा शत योजनम् आयता ।जातरूपमयी दिव्या विराजति स वेदिका ॥४-४०-५५॥
verses.transliteration: tasya koṭiḥ divam spṛṣṭvā śata yojanam āyatā ।jātarūpamayī divyā virājati sa vedikā ॥4-40-55॥

translations.english: 'The place looks beautiful with salas, palmyras, tamalas and karnikara trees in full bloom. These golden, divine flowers shine like the Sungod.
translations.hindi: इस पर्वत का अगला शिखर आकाशास्पशी हे ओर सी योजन लंबा है । वह सोने की दिव्य वेदी सहित वहाँ विराजमान है

verses.sloka: सालैः तालैः तमालैः च कर्णिकारैः च पुष्पितैः ।जातरूपमयैः दिव्यैः शोभते सूर्य सन्निभैः ॥४-४०-५६॥
verses.transliteration: sālaiḥ tālaiḥ tamālaiḥ ca karṇikāraiḥ ca puṣpitaiḥ ।jātarūpamayaiḥ divyaiḥ śobhate sūrya sannibhaiḥ ॥4-40-56॥

translations.english: 'There is a huge golden peak called Saumanas of ten yojanas in height spread over a breadth of one yojana.
translations.hindi: उस पर सुनहले दिव्य सूरय की तरह चमकीले और फूले हुए साल, ताल, तमाल और कनेर के पेड़ लगे हुए हैं.

verses.sloka: तत्र योजन विस्तारम् उच्छ्रितम् दश योजनम् ।शृंगम् सौमनसम् नाम जातरूपमयम् ध्रुवम् ॥४-४०-५७॥
verses.transliteration: tatra yojana vistāram ucchritam daśa yojanam ।śṛṁgam saumanasam nāma jātarūpamayam dhruvam ॥4-40-57॥

translations.english: 'When the supreme being, Visnu took his three strides as Lord Vamana, he placed his first foot on this peak and the second on the peak of mount Meru.
translations.hindi: डस पर्वेत पर सुवर्णमय एक सौमनस शिखर है जो एक योजन विस्तार बाला ( लम्बा ) ओर दस योजन ऊँचा है

verses.sloka: तत्र पूर्वम् पदम् कृत्वा पुरा विष्णुः त्रिविक्रमे ।द्वितीयम् शिखरम् मेरोः चकार पुरुषोत्तमः ॥४-४०-५८॥
verses.transliteration: tatra pūrvam padam kṛtvā purā viṣṇuḥ trivikrame ।dvitīyam śikharam meroḥ cakāra puruṣottamaḥ ॥4-40-58॥

translations.english: 'The Sun circumabulates Jambu island and when he arrives at this lofty cliff of the mountain, it takes the northern direction and becomes visible to the world.
translations.hindi: तत्र पूव पदं कृत्वा पुरा विष्णुस्तिविकमे । द्वितीय शिखरे मेरोश्चकार पुरुपोत्तम!!!५८॥ पूर्वकाल में पुरुषोत्तम अगवान विष्णु ने ( वामनावतार के समय ) तीन पग प्रथिवा नापने के समय, पहला पैर इसीके श्शङ्ग पर रखा था, और दूसरा पैर मेर पवेत के शिखर पर

verses.sloka: उत्तरेण परिक्रम्य जंबू द्वीपम् दिवाकरः ।दृश्यो भवति भूयिष्ठम् शिखरम् तन् महोच्छ्रयम् ॥४-४०-५९॥
verses.transliteration: uttareṇa parikramya jaṁbū dvīpam divākaraḥ ।dṛśyo bhavati bhūyiṣṭham śikharam tan mahocchrayam ॥4-40-59॥

translations.english: 'Over there the great ascetics Vaikhanasas and Valakhilyas appear like the radiating Sun.

verses.sloka: तत्र वैखानसा नाम वालखिल्या महर्षयः ।प्रकाशमाना दृश्यन्ते सूर्य वर्णाः तपस्विनः ॥४-४०-६०॥
verses.transliteration: tatra vaikhānasā nāma vālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ ।prakāśamānā dṛśyante sūrya varṇāḥ tapasvinaḥ ॥4-40-60॥

translations.english: 'The region in front of this mountain is called Sudarsana Island. This island is where the Sun who gives all beings the ability to see rises.
translations.hindi: सुर्य भगवान्‌ उत्तर की ओर से जम्बद्वीप की परिक्रमा करते हुए इसीके उच्च शिखर पर लोगों को भली भति देनन पड़ते हे ix तत्र वैखानसा नाम वालखिल्या महर्षयः । प्रकाशमाना श्यन्ते सूयेवणास्तपस्विनः

verses.sloka: अयम् सुदर्शनो द्वीपः पुरो यस्य प्रकाशते ।तस्मिन् तेजः च चक्षुः च सर्व प्राणभृताम् अपि ॥४-४०-६१॥
verses.transliteration: ayam sudarśano dvīpaḥ puro yasya prakāśate ।tasmin tejaḥ ca cakṣuḥ ca sarva prāṇabhṛtām api ॥4-40-61॥

translations.english: You should search for Ravana and Vaidehi on the peak of that mountain, in the caves, in the forests here and there.
translations.hindi: इसीके पास सुइशेन नामक द्वीप देख पड़ेगा | जब इस सौम- नस शिखर पर सूर्योदय होता है, तब सब प्राण्यों के नेत्रो में उजाला आता हे

verses.sloka: शैलस्य तस्य पृष्ठेषु कंदरेषु वनेषु च ।रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः ॥४-४०-६२॥
verses.transliteration: śailasya tasya pṛṣṭheṣu kaṁdareṣu vaneṣu ca ।rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ ॥4-40-62॥

translations.english: 'The early morning twilight appears bright red because of the glow of the golden mountain as well as of the great Sungod.

verses.sloka: कांचनस्य च शैलस्य सूर्यस्य च महात्मनः ।आविष्टा तेजसा संध्या पूर्वा रक्ता प्रकाशते ॥४-४०-६३॥
verses.transliteration: kāṁcanasya ca śailasya sūryasya ca mahātmanaḥ ।āviṣṭā tejasā saṁdhyā pūrvā raktā prakāśate ॥4-40-63॥

translations.english: 'Here is the entrance for the earth as well as for all the worlds and since the Sun also rises from this place it is called the eastern direction.

verses.sloka: पूर्वम् एतत् कृतम् द्वारम् पृथिव्या भुवनस्य च ।सूर्यस्य उदयनम् चैव पूर्वा हि एषा दिक् उच्यते ॥४-४०-६४॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvam etat kṛtam dvāram pṛthivyā bhuvanasya ca ।sūryasya udayanam caiva pūrvā hi eṣā dik ucyate ॥4-40-64॥

translations.english: 'You may look for Ravana and also for Vaidehi even behind the mountain on the plains and also near the mountain streams and caves all over.
translations.hindi: ब्रह्मा ने पूर्व में वदी पू दिशा रूप प्रथिवी ओर भुवनों का द्वार वनाया। इसी दिशा में सूर्य उदय हाते हैं, अतः इसे पूर्व दिशा कहते हैँ

verses.sloka: तस्य शलस्य पृष्ठेषु निर्झरेषु गुहासु च ।रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गतव्या ततः ततः ॥४-४०-६५॥
verses.transliteration: tasya śalasya pṛṣṭheṣu nirjhareṣu guhāsu ca ।rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgatavyā tataḥ tataḥ ॥4-40-65॥

translations.english: 'Beyond, there is no Sun or Moon. Darkness pervades. It is neither accessible nor visible. It is guarded by the gods.
translations.hindi: हेवानरश्रेष्ठो ! बस (यहीं तरु वानर लोग जा सकते हैं । इसके आगे का हाल सूय, का प्रकाश न होने से तथा मयोदाहीन होसे के कारण, स॒झे मालूम नहीं

verses.sloka: ततः परम् अगम्या स्यात् दिक् पूर्वा त्रिदश आवृता ।रहिता चन्द्र सूर्याभ्याम् अदृश्या तिमिर आवृता ॥४-४०-६६॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ param agamyā syāt dik pūrvā tridaśa āvṛtā ।rahitā candra sūryābhyām adṛśyā timira āvṛtā ॥4-40-66॥

translations.english: 'You should look for Janaki everywhere -- on the mountains, in the lakes and in the places not indicated by me.
translations.hindi: आरो देवता लोगों का निवासस्थान होने के कारण उस पवत के आगे पूर्व दिशा अगम्य है, अथत्‌(जाने के योग्य नहीं है । क्योंकि सूयं ओर चन्द्रमा के प्रकाश विना वहाँ सदैब अंधकार बना रहता है ओर कुछ सूझ नहीं पड़ता

verses.sloka: शैलेषु तेषु सर्वेषु कंदरेषु वनेषु च ।ये च न उक्ता मयोद्देशा विचेया तेषु जानकी ॥४-४०-६७॥
verses.transliteration: śaileṣu teṣu sarveṣu kaṁdareṣu vaneṣu ca ।ye ca na uktā mayoddeśā viceyā teṣu jānakī ॥4-40-67॥

translations.english: 'O chieftains monkeys can go that far. We know not what lies beyond those boundaries where no Sun shines.
translations.hindi: अतः तुरु उन पवंतों, गुह्दाओ और उन नदियों के तटवर्ती स्थानो में तथा उत्‌ देशों में, जिनके नाम मैंने नहों लिए हैं, जा कर जानकी को दू हना

verses.sloka: एतावत् वानरैः शक्यम् गन्तुम् वानर पुंगवाः ।अभास्करम् अमर्यादम् न जानीमः ततः परम् ॥४-४०-६८॥
verses.transliteration: etāvat vānaraiḥ śakyam gantum vānara puṁgavāḥ ।abhāskaram amaryādam na jānīmaḥ tataḥ param ॥4-40-68॥

translations.english: 'Reaching the mountain behind which the sun rises, look for Vaidehi and the home of Ravana and return by the month's end.

verses.sloka: अभिगम्य तु वैदेहीम् निलयम् रावणस्य च ।मासे पूर्णे निवर्तध्वम् उदयम् प्राप्य पर्वतम् ॥४-४०-६९॥
verses.transliteration: abhigamya tu vaidehīm nilayam rāvaṇasya ca ।māse pūrṇe nivartadhvam udayam prāpya parvatam ॥4-40-69॥

translations.english: 'If you do not report within one month, you will be killed. May you see Maithili and come back after reaching the goal.

verses.sloka: ऊर्ध्वम् मासात् न वस्तव्यम् वसन् वध्यो भवेन् मम ।सिद्ध अर्थाः संनिवर्तध्वम् अधिगम्य च मैथिलीम् ॥४-४०-७०॥
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvam māsāt na vastavyam vasan vadhyo bhaven mama ।siddha arthāḥ saṁnivartadhvam adhigamya ca maithilīm ॥4-40-70॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys go about the beloved quarter (east) of Indra bestowed with differnt kinds of forests and groves. Look out carefully for Rama's beloved Sita, spot her and return, you will live happily. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकांडे चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortieth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: महेन्द्र कांताम् वन षण्ड मण्डिताम्दिशम् चरित्वा निपुणेन वानराः ।अवाप्य सीताम् रघु वंशज प्रियाम्ततो निवृत्ताः सुखिनो भविष्यथ ॥४-४०-७१॥
verses.transliteration: mahendra kāṁtām vana ṣaṇḍa maṇḍitāmdiśam caritvā nipuṇena vānarāḥ ।avāpya sītām raghu vaṁśaja priyāmtato nivṛttāḥ sukhino bhaviṣyatha ॥4-40-71॥
